structure.note: Weighted voting rights: each Class A share has 10 votes and each Class B share one vote, except on a limited number of Reserved Matters where every share has one vote. The WVR beneficiaries at 31 December 2025 were Lei Jun (4,063,148,182 Class A shares, about 61.0% of votes on ordinary matters) and co-founder Lin Bin (448,404,962 Class A shares, about 6.7%). Lei Jun's shares are held through trusts he settled for the benefit of himself and his family (ARK Trust (Hong Kong) Limited as trustee). When Xiaomi repurchases Class B shares, the WVR beneficiaries convert Class A into Class B shares one-for-one so the WVR proportion does not rise.

notes: No SEC filings; all figures come from the Xiaomi 2025 Annual Report as published on HKEXnews (28 April 2026), reporting in RMB (ISO CNY). OWNERSHIP is as at 31 December 2025 from the SFO Part XV registers. The report states Lei Jun's interests only as % of each share class, so leader.derived computes 23.25% of all issued shares (Class A plus Class B); pctEconomic is null. The denominators are the class totals the report's own class percentages use (based on shares in issue at 31 December 2025; note 25(b) shows 133,607 thousand repurchased shares not yet cancelled at that date, while the Directors' Report says no treasury shares were held). pctVoting 61.0% is the report's figure for his Class A shares only on non-reserved matters; the report does not state a voting % that includes his Class B shares. ARK Trust's 9.98% of Class B also includes 156,252,115 Class B shares held for other trusts, which is not added. LARGEST HOLDERS: BlackRock is listed at 5.16% of Class B only (basis 'class'), so it is not used for 'everyone else'. Co-founder and director Lin Bin is disclosed only per class (448,404,962 Class A, 9.94%, via Apex Star LLC; Class B interests of 7.93%, 0.43%, 0.24% and 0.14%), and combining them would be a derivation the schema does not allow for holders. DIVIDENDS: none paid; the Board resolved not to declare a final dividend for 2025. The RMB 1,964k paid to non-controlling interests is excluded. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow line 'Payments for shares repurchase' (RMB 6,172,545k); the treasury-share note shows RMB 6,585,318k of shares repurchased in 2025 on a trade basis. In March 2025 Xiaomi also placed 800,000,000 new Class B shares (HK$42.6 billion gross). STOCK COMP: the Note 9 employee benefit line (RMB 5,365,075k).

paidout.notes: IFRS (HKEX 2025 annual report). Income tax paid is inside operating activities (not added). Finance expenses paid are in financing (added). Interest income received (3,276,391), investment income received and dividends received are in investing, so they do not lower OCF. Loan-book growth inside OCF is flagged (financeReceivablesInOCF). Judgement: deferred payments for intangible assets booked in financing (2,499,913) are excluded from capex; including them, paidOut would be 439.188138 bn.
